svg.text: ERP Integration | Node.js + Puppeteer + Bull Queue + AWS S3
Node.js 20 LTS · Docker · EC2 t3.medium (2 vCPU, 4GB RAM)
Rate limiting (100 req/s) · Auth middleware · Request validation
Client → Django → PDF Service → render → sign → S3 upload → signed URL returned
Client → Django → freeze data snapshot → enqueue jobs → return job_id
Workers process in parallel → ZIP assembled → S3 upload → SSE complete event
Worker publishes to Redis channel → Django SSE endpoint streams to client
Client stores Last-Event-ID; reconnects resume without data loss
POST /verify → recompute HMAC-SHA256 of PDF bytes → compare with stored hash
Hash also stored in PDF XMP metadata for offline verification
Worker partitions HTML into chunks → renders separately → merges with pdf-lib
⚠ 4 workers handle ~80 PDF/min → queue buffers the rest
Queue depth at peak: ~920 jobs → cleared in ~11.5 min
Signed URL download (S3 direct, bypasses app server)
